plugins.description: Five-step pipeline (explore → assemble → audit → kickoff → materialize) for turning a high-level app idea into audited requirements/design docs, a launch plan with an agent-neutral init-kickoff instruction that sets up an OpenSpec-ready repository, and OpenSpec changes with a dependency-checked implementation order and parallelism analysis.
